records.text: Record header: Drift Ledger — Concept. Field guide definition: It is a method for recording small route deviations together with their causes and corrections, so later plans can distinguish recurring drift from one-off detours.
Record header: Lantern Threshold — Concept. Workshop transcript. Inez Calder reported: "It is a rule for starting a field check only after three independent visibility readings agree."

Archive memorandum HR-17 states: "For the interval beginning 2024-04-01T00:00:00.000Z and ending exclusively at 2024-07-01T00:00:00.000Z, Harbor Ratio meant the share of inspection hours reserved for tide-dependent work."
